scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run build && npx cap run android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.aab:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
